
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/orihard/p/19130736" title="发布于 2025-10-09 11:25">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">数据采集传输卡：430-基于RFSOC的8路5G ADC和8路10G的DAC PCIe卡</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<table style="width: 91%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" align="center">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td height="80">
<div align="center">
<h2>基于RFSOC的8路5G ADC和8路10G的DAC PCIe卡</h2>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>
<table style="width: 94%" border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" align="center">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>
<h3 align="center"><span style="font-family: 宋体"><img alt="" data-src="http://www.orihard.com/files/430-1.jpg" class="lazyload"></span></h3>
<h3 align="left"><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">一、板卡概述</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 板卡使用Xilinx的第三代RFSOC系列，单颗芯片包含8路ADC和DAC，64-bit&nbsp;Cortex&nbsp;A53系列4核CPU，Cortex-R5F实时处理核，以及大容量FPGA。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 对主机接口采用PCIe&nbsp;Gen3x16，配合PCIe&nbsp;DMA传输，支持高速数据采集和传输。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center"><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><img alt="" data-src="http://www.orihard.com/files/430-02.gif" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p><img alt="08a4cb3887c5ff755f20f8f7a2864de8_430-02" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/657802/202510/657802-20251009112145539-37676665.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><strong>二、板卡特性：</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">基于Zynq&nbsp;RFSoC系列FPGA，支持8路最高5G&nbsp;ADC和8路最高10G的DAC</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">PL&nbsp;2组64bit&nbsp;2400M&nbsp;DDR4，支持PL部分高速存储和处理。&nbsp;单组4GB字节容量，PL部分8GB字节容量。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">标准PCIe全高半长板型（167&nbsp;x&nbsp;111&nbsp;mm&nbsp;），适配常见主机、服务器</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">PCIe&nbsp;Gen3&nbsp;x16，高速数据通讯，附带DMA传输例程</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">可快速修改版型，支持客户定制开发</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">PS部分1组64bit位宽DDR4，单组4GB字节</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">可配置的Dual&nbsp;QSPI&nbsp;加载</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">支持MicroSD卡加载</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">1000Base-T以太网（RJ45）端口（CPU端）</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">USB接口支持</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">支持外部时钟输入</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;<strong>三、FPGA设计框图：</strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="430-3" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/657802/202510/657802-20251009112250577-942553227.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; PL部分，主要分为：</span></p>
<ol>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">PCIe&nbsp;DMA部分，PCIe分为寄存器通道和数据DMA通道，寄存器用于板卡控制和状态监控，数据DMA用于读取ADC采集的数据。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">DDR4控制管理，包括ADC的数据写入DDR4，以及上位机从DDR4中读取数据。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">RF硬件控制，用于控制板卡上PLL，ADC和DAC控制。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">数据处理模块，即用户的数据处理部分。可根据客户的要求定制开发。</span></li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 板卡时钟灵活，支持多种应用配置，模拟部分的时钟，采用LMK04828，双PLL锁相环。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 如果采用板内时钟，用TCXO和VCXO双锁相环，提供稳定可靠的模拟时钟。同时也输出一路给FPGA进行数字处理。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 该方案也支持使用外部独立输入时钟，通过LMK04828扇出后输出给ADC和DAC。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center"><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><img alt="" data-src="http://www.orihard.com/files/430-4.jpg" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;<img alt="430-4" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/657802/202510/657802-20251009112344509-809018634.jpg" class="lazyload"></span></span></span>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; 数字部分，使用高集成度的SI5341B，单路芯片输出PS和PL所需的各路时钟。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="430-5" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/657802/202510/657802-20251009112359107-1242837280.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center"><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><img alt="" data-src="http://www.orihard.com/files/430-5.jpg" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small">&nbsp;</span></span>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><strong>四、部分测试结果：<img alt="430-6" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/657802/202510/657802-20251009112414352-1989994178.jpg" class="lazyload"></strong></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p align="center"><span style="font-family: 宋体; font-size: small"><img alt="" data-src="http://www.orihard.com/files/430-6.jpg" class="lazyload"></span></p>
</td>
